container_info.description:
**Product Overview**

Mobile Service Hub is a web-based service booking and management system designed to address the challenges customers face in finding reliable mobile repair services, comparing prices, and booking technicians. The platform also supports service centers in managing service requests, technicians, and billing. The system targets Super Admins, Service Center Admins, Technicians, and Customers, providing a centralized solution for booking and managing mobile repair services.

**Main Objectives**
- Centralize mobile repair service bookings for customers
- Enable efficient management of jobs, technicians, and billing for service centers
- Support multiple user roles: Super Admin, Service Center Admin, Technician, Customer

**Expected Outcomes**
- Streamlined booking process for customers
- Improved operational efficiency for service centers
- Transparent billing and reporting
- Scalable platform for future enhancements (e.g., online payments, inventory management, customer feedback)

steps.name: Environment setup and global env persistence
steps.description: Validate node/npm presence and version (require Node >=18). Compute npm global bin path and write an idempotent, single-quoted /etc/profile.d snippet that conditionally prepends the absolute NPM_GBIN at login (no premature $PATH expansion). Do not run npm at shell init. Ensure workspace exists and export NODE_ENV and API_BASE_URL for current session only if not already set. Fail fast with clear exit codes if sudo/profile write fails.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-service-hub-41952-42033/MobileServiceHubMonolith"
[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ] || mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
NODE_BIN=$(command -v node || true); NPM_BIN=$(command -v npm || true)
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] || [ -z "$NPM_BIN" ]; then echo "node or npm not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
NODE_V=$($NODE_BIN -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_V" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/' || true)
case "$NODE_MAJOR" in
""|*[!0-9]*) echo "unable to parse node version ($NODE_V)" >&2; exit 3 ;;
*) if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "node major version $NODE_MAJOR < 18 required" >&2; exit 4; fi ;;
esac
# compute npm global bin (absolute path) now
NPM_GBIN=$($NPM_BIN bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
PROFILE_FILE="/etc/profile.d/mobile_service_hub_env.sh"
TMPFILE=$(mktemp)
# Use single-quoted heredoc so variables like $PATH are not expanded now
cat > "$TMPFILE" <<'PROFILE'
# MobileServiceHub development environment (created by setup script)
# Conditionally prepend a resolved npm global bin if present on disk
if [ -n "__NPM_GBIN__" ] && [ -d "__NPM_GBIN__" ]; then
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":__NPM_GBIN__:") ;;
    *) export PATH="__NPM_GBIN__:$PATH";;
  esac
fi
# Only set NODE_ENV to development when not already set
[ -z "${NODE_ENV:-}" ] && export NODE_ENV=development
# Minimal API base for headless dev (can be overridden by user env)
[ -z "${API_BASE_URL:-}" ] && export API_BASE_URL="http://localhost:4000"
PROFILE
# replace placeholder with actual NPM_GBIN or empty string
sed "s|__NPM_GBIN__|${NPM_GBIN:-}|g" "$TMPFILE" >"${TMPFILE}.out"
sudo tee "$PROFILE_FILE" <"${TMPFILE}.out" >/dev/null || { echo "failed to write $PROFILE_FILE" >&2; rm -f "$TMPFILE" "${TMPFILE}.out"; exit 5; }
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
rm -f "$TMPFILE" "${TMPFILE}.out"
# export for current shell without overwriting existing values
[ -z "${NODE_ENV:-}" ] && export NODE_ENV=development
[ -z "${API_BASE_URL:-}" ] && export API_BASE_URL="http://localhost:4000"
exit 0

steps.name: Install local dependencies (idempotent, prefer npm ci, retry)
steps.description: Install project-local dependencies non-interactively in the workspace. Prefer 'npm ci' when package-lock.json exists for reproducible installs. Retry transient network failures up to 2 additional times with short backoff. Do not modify package.json during install. If local vite installation fails and no local vite binary is available, allow using the preinstalled global vite with a logged warning (but prefer local). Write all logs to .logs and verify required local binaries exist; record which binary (local vs global) was used.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-service-hub-41952-42033/MobileServiceHubMonolith"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
RETRIES=3; SLEEP=2
run_npm_ci(){ npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOGDIR/npm_ci.log" 2>&1; }
run_npm_install(){ npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOGDIR/npm_install.log" 2>&1; }
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite" ] && [ -d "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/react" ]; then
  echo "local deps present" >"$LOGDIR/install_status.log"
  exit 0
fi
# choose install strategy
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  attempt=1
  until run_npm_ci && break || [ $attempt -ge $RETRIES ]; do
    attempt=$((attempt+1)); sleep $SLEEP
  done
  if [ $attempt -ge $RETRIES ] && [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite" ]; then
    echo "npm ci failed after retries; see $LOGDIR/npm_ci.log" >&2
  fi
else
  attempt=1
  until run_npm_install && break || [ $attempt -ge $RETRIES ]; do
    attempt=$((attempt+1)); sleep $SLEEP
  done
  if [ $attempt -ge $RETRIES ] && [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite" ]; then
    echo "npm install failed after retries; see $LOGDIR/npm_install.log" >&2
  fi
fi
# verify local vite; if missing, allow fallback to global vite but log it
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite" ]; then
  echo "local vite used" >"$LOGDIR/vite_choice.log"
elif command -v vite >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "local vite missing; using global vite" >"$LOGDIR/vite_choice.log"
else
  echo "vite not available locally or globally; install failed" >&2
  [ -f "$LOGDIR/npm_install.log" ] && cat "$LOGDIR/npm_install.log" >&2
  [ -f "$LOGDIR/npm_ci.log" ] && cat "$LOGDIR/npm_ci.log" >&2
  exit 7
fi
# verify react
if [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/react" ]; then
  echo "react not installed locally; attempting to continue if global available" >"$LOGDIR/install_status.log"
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-service-hub-41952-42033/MobileServiceHubMonolith"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
# fail if test deps missing; dependencies step must install them
for dep in node_modules/jest node_modules/babel-jest node_modules/@babel/preset-react node_modules/react-test-renderer; do
  if [ ! -d "$dep" ]; then echo "test dependency missing: $dep" >&2; exit 8; fi
done
# jest config for transforming JSX via babel-jest
if [ ! -f jest.config.js ]; then
  cat > jest.config.js <<'JCFG'
module.exports = { testEnvironment: 'jsdom', transform: { '^.+\\.[tj]sx?$': 'babel-jest' } };
JCFG
fi
# smoke test
mkdir -p __tests__
cat > __tests__/app-smoke.test.jsx <<'TEST'
import React from 'react'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-service-hub-41952-42033/MobileServiceHubMonolith"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
VITE_LOCAL="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite"
VITE_BIN="$VITE_LOCAL"
USE_GLOBAL=0
if [ ! -x "$VITE_LOCAL" ]; then
  if command -v vite >/dev/null 2>&1; then VITE_BIN=$(command -v vite); USE_GLOBAL=1; echo "using global vite" >"$LOGDIR/vite_choice.log"; else echo "vite not available" >&2; exit 10; fi
fi
# Build
"$VITE_BIN" build >"$LOGDIR/vite_build.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOGDIR/vite_build.log" >&2; echo "build_failed" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_result"; exit 11; }
if [ ! -f dist/index.html ]; then echo "dist/index.html missing after build" >&2; cat "$LOGDIR/vite_build.log" >&2; echo "build_missing_artifact" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_result"; exit 12; fi
# Start dev server in new process group
PORT=5173
setsid "$VITE_BIN" --port $PORT >"$LOGDIR/vite_dev.log" 2>&1 &
DEV_PID=$!
# get process group id
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$DEV_PID" | tr -d ' ')
# wait up to 30s
TIMEOUT=30; ok=0
for i in $(seq 1 $TIMEOUT); do
  if curl -sSf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ || true)
# inspect dev log for errors
if grep -i -E 'error|failed' "$LOGDIR/vite_dev.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEV_LOG_ERRORS=1; else DEV_LOG_ERRORS=0; fi
# stop server (kill entire process group) if started
if [ -n "$PGID" ] && [ "$PGID" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
  sudo kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# wait for process to exit
if [ -n "$DEV_PID" ]; then
  wait "$DEV_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
# compose validation result
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_result" <<EOF
build=ok
build_log=$LOGDIR/vite_build.log
dev_server_used=$( [ $USE_GLOBAL -eq 1 ] && echo global || echo local )
dev_server_health_http_status=$HTTP_STATUS
dev_server_log=$LOGDIR/vite_dev.log
dev_server_log_had_errors=$DEV_LOG_ERRORS
test_result_file=$WORKSPACE/.validation_test_result
EOF
# if server was unreachable mark failure
if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ] || [ "$DEV_LOG_ERRORS" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "validation failed; see $WORKSPACE/.validation_result and logs" >&2
  exit 13
fi
exit 0

dev_server_log=$LOGDIR/vite_dev.log
